results.description: Compare OtherLibrary.ValidInputPointer@1 with REQ_COMP_EXTRA_004 and record how non-nullness, lifetime, and absence of concurrent modification are covered.
results.result: REQ_COMP_EXTRA_004 version 1 references OtherLibrary.ValidInputPointer@1. Taking the address of a call-local const uint8_t supplies a non-null pointer, a lifetime enclosing the synchronous call, and an object without a mutable alias. results.description: Enumerate all Compute calls in unit_1 and review the argument object, pointer escapes, lifetime, and possible writers. Confirm the reviewed call sites cover the unit_1 implementation target.
results.result: unit_1_lib lists only foo.cpp and foo.h. The sole Compute call is in Foo::GetNumber. It passes &value, where value is a call-local const std::uint8_t initialized to 42. The address is not otherwise exposed; separate invocations have separate objects. The object remains alive until the call returns and GetNumber exits.
